OAKFIELD RAILWAY STATION
Opened 14 June 1862
For over a century this station connected the village with the wider world. Its restoration celebrates the railway workers, travellers and local families whose lives shaped this place.
Restored by the Oakfield Heritage Trust

THE OLD SCHOOL HOUSE
Built in 1876
For more than a century this building served the children of the village. Restored in 2026 by the local community, it now welcomes future generations as a place of learning, friendship and discovery.
The restoration honours the teachers, pupils and volunteers who made this school the heart of village life.
Remembering our past. Building our future.

VISITOR INFORMATION
Please keep dogs on a lead.

Thank you for helping to protect this special place.
